CatalogPreferences.title: CatalogPreferences
CatalogPreferences.description: Individual user preferences tracking hidden built-in catalog items across sessions.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owning this preference document.

hiddenBuiltinKeys.description: Bounded list of built-in publication keys hidden by this user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last preference update.

CloudPublication.title: CloudPublication
CloudPublication.description: A user-owned publication entry linked via HTTPS PDF URL and synchronized in Firestore.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner who created and can delete this publication.

rutaPdf.description: Public HTTPS URL pointing to the PDF file.

rutaPortada.description: Optional HTTPS URL pointing to a cover image.

UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Isolated private PII profile document strictly readable and writable only by the owner.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document parent userId.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the signed-in account header.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Stores per-user catalog preferences (e.g., hidden built-in publication keys).

/users/{userId}/publications/{publicatio.description: Stores personal cloud publications owned and deletable exclusively by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: PII-isolated private profile document accessible strictly by the verified owner.
